item.title: Episode 1: BeyondTrust zero-day and edge-device exploitation — 16 October 2026
item.description: Good morning, and welcome to Cyber Daily Australia, your daily cybersecurity situation report. This episode covers the twenty-four hours to eight thirty on the evening of Friday the sixteenth of October, twenty twenty-six, Melbourne time.
